claim: A wall standing under a parallax sky is drawn up to the sky.
evidence: projects/blood-city/level/l3_station.py, the train shed note: 'I had written that a wall under a parallax sky runs to the sky. It runs to its sector's ceiling; the sky is drawn above that.'
NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:4721 the upper step is drawn between the two sectors' ceilings
use: Give anything with openings a ceiling at its own roof height, or build it of sectors whose floors are its walls' tops.
instead: A wall runs to its own sector's ceiling height and the sky is drawn above that. A free-standing car or kiosk under the open sky can have no door or window band, because the wall over an opening runs to that sector's ceiling; under a roof at the object's own height it can.
